openHouses.description: This classic Colonial farmhouse is tucked in on one of Bedford's most coveted streets in the Guard Hill estate area. The four bedroom home was just completely reimagined and blends timeless character with brand-new, gut-renovated interiors. The picturesque drive leads to level land that sets the stage, leading to a classic rocking chair front porch that hints at the warmth inside.
